experience.summary: Analyzed historical B2B order data, seasonal demand patterns, and after-sales service records using Excel, SQL, and Python. Identified recurring client requirements to support demand forecasting, proactive production planning, and maintenance scheduling, contributing to improved planning efficiency and engineering resource utilization.

researchAreas.description: Analyzed historical B2B order data and seasonal demand trends using Excel and SQL to identify recurring purchasing patterns and anticipate future client requirements.

researchAreas.title: PRODUCTION PLANNING OPTIMIZATION
researchAreas.description: Leveraged historical order patterns to anticipate repeat orders and align production schedules with projected client demand, contributing to an approximately 18% improvement in production planning efficiency.

researchAreas.title: AFTER-SALES SERVICE & RESOURCE PLANNING
researchAreas.description: Analyzed historical maintenance and service requirements to anticipate after-sales demand, enabling better engineer scheduling and workforce utilization.

highlights: Applied Excel, SQL, and Python to analyze historical order data and identify recurring B2B purchasing patterns.

experience.summary: Investigated 3D chipless RFID structures through electromagnetic simulation, MATLAB-based data processing, and experimental validation, focusing on improving tag performance and extracting reliable resonant signatures.

researchAreas.title: DATA PROCESSING
researchAreas.description: Processed 20K+ RFID signatures through a modular MATLAB workflow, converting simulation outputs into structured data for analysis.

researchAreas.title: CONFIGURATION ANALYSIS
researchAreas.description: Compared four resonator configurations and multiple feed variations to identify patterns associated with improved chipless RFID performance.

researchAreas.title: VALIDATION
researchAreas.description: Cross-checked experimental results against simulation outputs, investigated discrepancies, and refined a reproducible analytical workflow.
